sources.title: Custom Models · Documentation · Pi
sources.snippet: The apiKey value is a placeholder because Ollama ignores it. pi still treats models as requiring auth before they appear in /model, so keyless local servers should keep a dummy value, save a key for that provider with /login, or pass --api-key when selecting the model.
